name: Grand Hyatt Bogota
positioning: City hotel in a Bogota business area near the American Embassy and El Dorado Airport, with views of the Andes, a 13th-floor Grand Club lounge, a helipad event venue and Zaitania Spa
best_for: Business travelers who want easy access to El Dorado Airport and the Agora Bogota Convention Center
Guests who want room views over gardens, the city or the Andes Mountains
Longer stays in a suite with a kitchen and laundry room

facts.text: The hotel's rooms are perched above one of Bogota's business hot spots.
The hotel's rooms are near the American Embassy in Bogota.
The hotel is located near the Agora Bogota Convention Center.
El Dorado International Airport is 10 kilometers from the hotel.
Standard guest rooms measure 41 square meters and have floor-to-ceiling windows.
The spa is called Zaitania, which in Muisca means 'the beginning of the world.'
Zaitania Spa's treatment rooms include two Vichy showers and three rooms dedicated exclusively to couples.
The hotel has an indoor pool and a hot tub.
Grand Club guests enjoy continental breakfast, refreshments throughout the day, and cocktails and hors d'oeuvres at sunset.
The Andes View Corner Suite has Andes views, a king bed, a walk-in closet, a work desk and Grand Club lounge access.
Ushin Japanese & Grill, on the hotel's 18th floor, serves Japanese dishes and meats grilled over Binchotan charcoal.
Capitalino Restaurant has an outdoor terrace.

highlights.text: The hotel's helipad, overlooking Bogota's skyline and the Andes Mountains, is a venue for events and panoramic sunsets.
The spa has a swimming pool, hydrotherapy circuit, sauna and steam room.
The floor-to-ceiling windows in rooms and suites overlook gardens, the city lights or the Andes Mountains.
The Grand Club lounge is on the 13th floor, with views of the city and the Andes Mountains.
The Two Bedroom Suite suits long stays, with an open kitchen with oven, dining table, living area, two king bedrooms, a laundry room and Grand Club lounge access.

considerations.text: The hotel is in a business area; guests head out from the hotel to explore Bogota's historic center, the Gold Museum and Monserrate Hill.
Dogs must be kept out of Ushin Japanese & Grill and the spa.
WhataHotel notes the high-altitude location may affect some guests.
